_comment: What the release packages bundle beside sharexrs, pinned by URL and SHA256 (docs/RELEASING.md). scripts/fetch-bundled.py downloads, checks and lays these out. Bump a piece by changing its url, sha256 and member together.

ffmpeg._comment: ShareX's CI downloads BtbN's FFmpeg-Builds 'ffmpeg-n9.0-latest-<win64|winarm64>-gpl-9.0' (FFMPEG_VERSION 9.0) from the rolling 'latest' release. These are the same builds from a month-end autobuild, which BtbN keeps, so the hash can be pinned. BtbN has no macOS build: macOS uses Martin Riedl's static FFmpeg 9.0.2 release build.
